title: Canary failure aftershocks: detection, operational runbook and action triage
creator: Diego Morales
description: Summary: During a controlled canary rollout of model-variant v2.3.1 (text-gen family) on 2025-02-14 we observed a transient regression: a spike in hallucination-like outputs for a subset of prompts and a correlated increase in p95 latency. The canary's auto-rollback triggered, but follow-on effects (cache inconsistency and traffic routing oscillation) produced 'aftershock' faults for ~22 minutes before stable rollback completed. This ticket collates the incident timeline, defines a clear operational runbook for aftershock detection, and lists prioritized engineering follow-ups to prevent recurrence.
runbook_summary: Purpose: Provide step-by-step triage for 'aftershock' symptoms after an automated canary rollback. Key detection signals: 1) 'model_response_integrity' alert (see telemetry_changes) 2) sustained p95 latency > 500ms for model variant OR p50 latency increase > 50ms over baseline for 5m 3) cross-route 5xx rate increase > 0.5% absolute vs baseline in 3m. Immediate ops steps: - Pause canary traffic ramp (Console: Canary -> Pause) OR set routing policy to 'stable-only' if pause fails. - Enforce sticky routing to avoid oscillation for in-flight requests. - If KV cache miss-rate > 15% for affected pods, trigger cache-warm job (scripts/run/cache_warmup.sh) and mark affected nodes for graceful restart. - If hallucination signature rate > threshold, isolate canary variant and preserve samples (S3 prefix: s3://redwood-incidents/canary-samples/YYYYMMDD). - When rollback is underway, do NOT reintroduce unique model-specific KV prefixes until cache is validated. - Post-rollback validation: run the 'smoke-metric-suite' against control traffic and check model_response_integrity for <0.1% drift.
telemetry_changes: New/adjusted metrics to implement: - model_response_integrity (derived score 0-1) computed with a small trusted prompt set executed in production shadow every 2 minutes. Alert: score drop >= 0.15 sustained for 3 samples. - per-variant token_error_tag (counts tokens with truncation, malformed JSON, or 'I don't know' patterns). Alert: token_error_tag rate > 0.8% in 5m. - canary_traffic_oscillation_rate (counts routing changes per minute); alert at > 3/minute. - kv_cache_miss_rate per node and per-variant; alert > 15%. Implementation: add collectors to telemetry agent and a lightweight ShadowProbe job (k8s CronJob) to exercise trusted prompts. Also add a high-cardinality tag 'canary_variant' to existing latency and error metrics.
action_items: 1) Runtime: Add conservative cooldown to auto-rollback so traffic is ramped down to 20% then 0% over 90s instead of immediate cut. Owner: Priya Singh. Due: 2025-03-12. 2) Telemetry: Implement model_response_integrity and ShadowProbe; add alert and synthetic dashboards. Owner: Marco Ruiz. Due: 2025-03-05. 3) KV cache safety: ensure model-specific prefixes are namespaced and add atomic swap for cache promotion to avoid stale keys during rollback. Owner: Li Wei. Due: 2025-03-19. 4) Canary config: add 'sticky routing' flag and an explicit 'hold' state for canaries that prevents automated reroutes while manual triage is active. Owner: Asha Patel. Due: 2025-03-02. 5) Postmortem doc & training: create a short training runbook and tabletop exercise for on-call and SRE. Owner: Diego Morales. Due: 2025-03-14. 6) PRD update: Add acceptance criteria for A/B tests and shadow traffic validating both integrity and latency budgets prior to canary release. Owner: Priya Singh. Due: 2025-03-07.
